newsitem.title: USA: Brown Group posts mixed sales for May.
newsitem.headline: Brown Group posts mixed sales for May.

text.p: Brown Group Inc said Thursday same-store sales rose 2.1 percent at its Famous Footwear division but fell 3.6 percent at its Naturalizer unit during May.
Famous Footwear, a chain of 800 stores selling brand-name shoes, posted total sales of $64.9 million, up 7.7 percent for May, the company said.
Naturalizer, a chain of 346 stores selling the Naturalizer brand women's shoes, reported total sales dropped 3.9 percent to $12 million in May.
